text.text: Armor for a wolf, built from Tinkers' materials. Three parts: the plating decides armour and toughness, the lining carries the material traits, and the binding holds it together.
Right-click a tamed wolf with the armor to put it on, and sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it off. The wolf keeps it in its own chest slot, so it survives save and reload.

properties: Armour value and durability come from the plating material
Fits a wolf, not a player
